name: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan (Standard)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 362,000/month + JPY 200,000 settling-in allowance + round-trip airfare + travel insurance
other_rules: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan (not Japanese citizens or permanent residents)
doctorate within 6 years of 1 April of the fellowship year (FY2027: awarded on or after 2 April 2021) or expected before the start date
no previous JSPS Standard or PU fellowship
notes: Two routes: a Japanese host applies through open recruitment in Japan, or you apply through your country's overseas nominating authority, which sets its own deadline. 12-24 months; FY2027 start window 1 Apr to 30 Nov 2027. Results about 3 months after JSPS receives the application.
